prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1284; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the injury described and is plausible for a collision of this type. Over four visits, care included passive and active range-of-motion exercises, a home exercise program, and monitoring of pain levels. Treatment continued somewhat longer than is typical for this presentation, reflecting a gradual rather than rapid response. Examination showed reduced abduction and tenderness over the rotator cuff, which support the reported injury. Other findings, including neurovascular status and strength testing in the upper extremity, were within normal limits. No prior injury to the right shoulder is known to this provider. Billing records reviewed for these four visits show no repeated charges for the same services.
